explanation: EXCLURAD (eta channel) ran to completion (exit code 0) for this point using standard CLAS12 settings (RG-K beam energy 6.53 GeV, vcut 0.166 GeV^2, full O(alpha) radiative-correction mode), which passed preflight (production threshold, cos(theta*) pole, Q2/beam accessibility, and lookup-table coverage all PASS). sigma_born was computed successfully: 0.0008651649 (as written in radtot, units per the eta radtot column convention). However, delta (the radiative correction factor) came out as NaN: one of the internal 'tai' sub-integrations that build the radiative-correction numerator failed to converge to a finite value (stdout showed 'tai:  NaN  0.1921E-03  10791  0' for one of the five v-bins at kinematic index 3), and this NaN propagated into delta and the asymmetry columns (asym_obs and asym_rc) in radtot and both rows of radcor, while leaving sigma_born and asym_born (which do not depend on that integral) unaffected. This is not a physical impossibility of the kinematic point (preflight passed cleanly) but a numerical failure of one RC sub-integral at this specific (W, Q2, cos theta*, phi*) combination, so delta is reported as null rather than a fabricated or rounded number.
